sourceRefs.locator: Attestation 951: the three named visitors at Andelao in 587, identified with Andelot-Blancheville.
BK 6, Date, Captions and Transmission: November 587 and preservation in Gregory IX.20. Nineteenth-century editions give the 29th; the map uses the year.
Q1332796, coordinate location (P625). Rounded to two decimal places.

summary.de: In Andelot trafen sich im November 587 Guntram, Childebert und Brunichild.
summary.en: Guntram, Childebert and Brunhild met at Andelot in November 587.
